reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a temporal action — a woman stepping off a night bus — and with no reference clips or subject plates supplied, the request is the only authority for action.
reasons.medium: No reference media are attached and the medium decision records no source medium to preserve or convert, so rendering medium rests entirely with the request (no restyling or retention is licensed).

reasons.lighting: No reference image exists whose lighting could be observed or retained. The night setting and rain are scene circumstances rather than a source of observed illumination, so lighting is request-governed by default rather than transferred from anything.
reasons.framing: No reference frames, aspect-derived compositions or observed shot scales are supplied; the explicit 16:9 canvas and the described action leave camera composition to the request.
reasons.palette: No reference palette can be observed with zero reference readings, so scene color remains request-governed; nothing is inherited from an absent source.
